/bin/zsh -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/r055
for f in *.pdf; do pdftotext -layout "$f" "/tmp/r055/${f%.pdf}.txt"; done
python3 - <<'"'PY'
import openpyxl as x,glob
for f in glob.glob('*.xlsx'):
 w=x.load_workbook(f,read_only=True,data_only=True)
 print(f,[(s.title,s.max_row,s.max_column) for s in w][:8],len(w.sheetnames))
 with open('/tmp/r055/'+f+'.txt','w') as o:
  for s in w:
   if 'kessan' in f and '沖縄' not in s.title: continue
   if 'jisatsu' in f and '15' not in s.title: continue
   print(s.title,file=o)
   for row in s:
    print(' '.join(f'{c.coordinate}={c.value"'!r}'"' for c in row if c.value is not None),file=o)
PY"
